name: Scout v4
title: Scout v4
note: Scout v4 shape design (8 Nov, Spark: new props, no Bee35, everything printed in PCTG, still seats in the landing funnel for the battery swapper): Gemfan 5125 props on a printed frame, the v3 base and battery unchanged, a half cage on the new discs. -160..162 x -160..160 x -48..132 mm, ~737 g (E). tools/scout_v4_shape.py

parts.name: frame v4 room (printed PCTG deck, arms and motor pods: the design envelope)
parts.note: replaces the Bee35 plate: deck x -60..60, |y| 40, z 18.5..24.5 (the plate's underside kept, the units bolt up into it), arms 18 wide to O30 pods at (+-74.3, +-74.3), a lug down each side to z -14 for the cage's side triangles, a socket at the tail end; mass at 45 % of the envelope (E, the engine sizes it); printed in PCTG

parts.name: base v4 room (yokes over the receiver, nose bay, flow pod, tail tray, nose stub)
parts.note: the receiver-only seat (9 Nov, Spark: "seat the scout on the receiver alone"; the funnel's end walls move in for the Scout): no runners or keel. Yokes over the receiver (its top z 9.6 to the deck), the nose bay for the FC, the flow sensor's pod, the tail tray for the Radxa, UBEC and XR2, the stub out to NB; every bottom on the walls-in rule + 2 (zmin_walls_in); mass at 30 % of the envelope (E); printed in PCTG

parts.name: probe camera in its metal case on the tilt cradle (Arducam 12MP autofocus USB, B0FLX58WKZ; bracket off)
parts.note: nods about the SG90's axis from -20 to +90 deg; parked 15 deg up it is the front camera, lens (44, 0, 115), 61 x 50 deg, autofocus 10 cm to inf, 1080p 30 live, 12 MP stills; rolled out it is the ceiling probe. Camera in its case 45 (listing; the case is its heat spreader, Spark 9 Nov), printed cradle 2, TPU strap 1 (E); case 36 square, depth 20 E: measure

parts.name: probe light: two 25 x 8 mm bars of Clearhill 5 V COB strip, 4000 K, CRI 90 (B0F1YPP6QS)
parts.note: the strip's cut length is 25 mm; ~0.2 W a bar at 8 W/m; on printed fins either side of the case, nodding with it; on the DRV8833's B channel, DC or PWM >= 20 kHz

parts.name: probe head frame: clip on the blades' tip, base plate, the two brackets, SG90 tilt servo (DORHEA, B0DFKPVRC2)
parts.note: SG90 9 (shaft on the tilt axis, facing -y, held by its 32.8 tabs on the +y bracket; body per the typical drawing: measure), 470 uF capacitor on its lead 1 (its start draws > 1 A), clip, plate and brackets 2.5 (PCTG); an M3 screw is the idler in the -y bracket's boss

parts.name: probe turret housing: side plates, floor, drum cover and the throat (PCTG)
parts.note: side plates trimmed to clear the discs, floor, drum cover and a 30 mm throat for the 19 mm blades: 4 (thin walls), DRV8833 1, TPU lip 1, wires 1 (E); drawn see-through

parts.name: probe spool with its 40 T gear (module 0.8) on an M3 screw
parts.note: hub O30 21 wide, flanges O34, the two 19 mm blades and the camera cable wound on it; ~1.5 turns for the 150 mm roll-out; the blades' ends are fixed to it, so fully out is a hard stop

parts.name: probe pinion, 15 T, on the N20's shaft
parts.note: centres 22 from the spool's

parts.name: N20 6 V 300 rpm gear motor, no encoder (Augiimor, B0BZDC951L)
parts.note: 37 long (can 17 x O12, 3 mm D shaft 10); in a pocket in the deck, along y, under the props' keep-out band; it runs out or in to a stall (the blades' anchor out, the head seated in)

parts.name: the camera cable, coiled loosely in the drum
parts.note: a JST ZH 1.5 mm 4-pin lead into the camera's B4B-ZR socket and four thin wires (data pair twisted) to the USB-C breakout: up between the blades, round the spool, 2.5 turns of room in the drum for ~1.5

parts.name: the two blades from the spool up into the throat
parts.note: two 19 mm (3/4 in) steel tape strips, 0.2 m each with 0.15 m used, cut from one ordinary 3 m tape measure (its case and spring not used; 13 spare strips), curves facing (~22 g/m, E); ends set in printed clamp slots with epoxy (hardened steel: not drilled); their mass is all here

parts.name: probe mast, blade A (10 mm steel tape, curves facing)
parts.note: drawn 1 mm long above the throat; the page's timeline rolls it out to 150 mm and back (tools/scout_v4_timeline.py). Its mass is in the feed's

parts.name: receiver contact pads (4, keep-alive and seat sensing)
parts.note: bare O6 pads at (1.5 +- 30, +-29.5) on the receiver's bottom rim, against the box's probes in the ledges

parts.name: half cage v4, rods (3 mm carbon: the ring, the flat roof, end Vs and side fans)
parts.note: 34 rods, 3.81 m, every one 12 from the swept discs and none over or under a disc: ring at z 61 with flats at 155 (310 across), a flat roof (spine on y 0, hoop on x 0, nose / tail triangles), a V at each end and a fan at each side down to the bottom nodes, which hang on rod triangles to the deck's side lugs and tail (NB on the camera's mount)

parts.name: half cage v4, nodes (spheres for now: the node design comes once the geometry is settled)
parts.note: 16 cage nodes; the larger spheres are sockets printed into the frame and the base (NB on the nose stub, two on each side lug, the deck's tail end, the tail tray's end)
